summary: Items 1-5 met. `CdlATV vol; vol.val0 = vol.val2 = 0x80; vol.val1 = vol.val3 = 0;` with member reads matches SOTN bios.c:368-387 @db41b28 verbatim. CdlATV is declared once, in the shared include/libcd.h, which system.c includes. The round-2/3 `u8 vol[4]` defect is gone. Sandbox --disable all = 0, system.o is section-identical to the fresh build, and the SHA1 == oracle. g_cd_spu_voice is a `volatile u16 *` to 0x1F801C00, which is type-level MMIO. No BB2 header declares an SPU register struct, so the indexed accesses do not trip item 4. No FAKE constructs, and no false claims in the body.
hygiene_debt: SOTN reaches the same SPU registers through a register struct (D_80032D7C->main_volx/main_vol/cd_vol/spucnt). The BB2 body indexes g_cd_spu_voice[0xC0/0xC1/0xD5/0xD8/0xD9/0xDC/0xDD] raw. A shared SPU-register struct in a header would be clearer. 'spu_voice' also undersells the pointer: it is the SPU register-file base, and none of these accesses are voice registers.
The comment above the function says 'PsyQ 4.0 LIBCD bios.c v1.86', but AGENTS.md records the SDK as PsyQ 3.5 (libcd bios.c v1.86). The version label should be reconciled file-wide.
